shortFormVideos.title: Hoʻolauleʻa O Hāna (1970)
shortFormVideos.shortDescription: Community celebration in Hāna with hula hālau, oli, and kūpuna remarks. August 16, 1970.
shortFormVideos.longDescription: Community celebration in Hāna featuring hula hālau, traditional chant, and remarks from kūpuna. Filmed on August 16, 1970. Contains extended segments in ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi; auto-captions may be approximate where Hawaiian is spoken.

shortFormVideos.title: Nā Mele: An Evening of Slack-Key with Honokaʻa Musicians
shortFormVideos.shortDescription: Live slack-key and falsetto concert with Honokaʻa musicians, July 12, 1985.
shortFormVideos.longDescription: Live concert recording from July 12, 1985 featuring kī hōʻalu (slack-key guitar) and falsetto vocals from Honokaʻa-based musicians. Includes traditional mele and original compositions performed in front of a small community audience.

shortFormVideos.title: Maui County Fair 1992 — Community PSA
shortFormVideos.shortDescription: PSA for the 1992 Maui County Fair with volunteer sign-up info and parade schedule.
shortFormVideos.longDescription: Public service announcement promoting the 1992 Maui County Fair, with volunteer sign-up information and parade schedule. Produced at Akakū studios in Kahului. Approximately one minute.

shortFormVideos.title: Pacific Talk: Interview with Auntie Makaha
shortFormVideos.shortDescription: Talk-show interview with community elder Auntie Makaha about Hāmākua coast education programs.
shortFormVideos.longDescription: Pacific Talk episode from September 22, 2001 featuring an extended interview with community elder Auntie Makaha about education and youth programs on the Hāmākua coast. Includes audience Q&A in the second half.

shortFormVideos.title: Nā Leo News: Lahaina Banyan Tree Restoration Update
shortFormVideos.shortDescription: News segment on the Lahaina banyan tree restoration from the November 8, 2019 broadcast.
shortFormVideos.longDescription: Segment from the November 8, 2019 edition of Nā Leo News covering the ongoing restoration of the historic Lahaina banyan tree. Pulled from the full broadcast as a standalone Mux clip asset.
